author: smitdalt
body:
So, I made a mistake. 

I was frustrated with Avicus being 1.8 and the player count going down, so I thought it would be a real joy to get on an alt and hack. I fully admit to this of course, but I sincerely wish I hadn't done it. I really miss playing with my pals on the server and TeamSpeak. I really don't know what I was thinking at the time, but I probably wasn't thinking too hard. 

Anyways, I understand if the staff team doesn't think I should be allowed back onto the server, as I should have known better, but I would really like another chance. 

Thank you for taking the time to read this ;)
-smitdalt

(I would be willing to sort this out on Teamspeak or skype as well if you wish.)
